steps.text: 3:21 A.M. \ Clear
Downtown Lungmen, 'The Ends of the Earth' lounge, ruins

steps.name: Penguin Logistics
steps.text: Cheers!!

steps.name: Penguin Logistics
steps.text: Cheers!!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Whew, tonight sure was a good time.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: You wouldn't think it from the stinkin' pile of garbage we're sittin' in, but it was great. Just thinkin' about somebody else footin' the bill for all our expenses makes me all warm inside!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Texas, if you figured it out earlier, you should have told us.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: I just guessed.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You're a really bad liar, you know that...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The boss had it all planned out, didn't he? Don't sweat it~ Eating, drinking, and fighting are good for the body and good for the soul.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What's wrong? You're not going to join them?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No, I'm okay.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I just, how can I say this? I just feel like I can't accept it.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You get used to it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: If I'm used to it then it's all over.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Like what was everything tonight even for? And Emperor, he...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...gave his life to make the party more fun.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima, you told me you would be giving me a grade for my performance at Penguin Logistics, didn't you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I did. I've been thinking about it. And while you didn't exactly mesh with everybody, you made some great strides. That much is clear. Maybe...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm not staying here.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh? I thought with everything that happened, you'd need Penguin Logistics to be a springboard for you to bigger and better things.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: That was the original idea. Turns out you had that all figured out...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: It's not that I think Penguin Logistics is terrible. Well, it is terrible.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But I think, with Messengers like this, who live like this...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Even though my common sense tells me it's ridiculously dangerous...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I think it might be... what I actually want.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Or maybe it's like I'll start to question reality if I don't look at it this way.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...like one, completely insane dream.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yeah. Fistfights, explosions, and high altitude drops will do that to you.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Getting thrown into the deep end with Penguin Logistics isn't great for your mental health.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But if you've made your decision, and as your fellow Messenger, I wish you luck.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Especially since it means your father won't have any grounds to dock my pay.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: D- dad! I totally forgot about that. I need to talk to him. But what is he even doing right now...?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Mostima! Drink up!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Cheers.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What's with you suddenly flitting over here? You spilled all over yourself.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: If I take my eyes off you for one second, you could vanish. And I got a lottttt of questions to ask you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: A lot, huh...? Like about that incident back in Laterano?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: With your sister? Or maybe... my horns?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hahaha, you're dumbstruck? Oh, Exusiai, you never change. You're always so easy to read.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: MOS! TI! MA!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: All right, all right. I'll tell you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...But right not now. You've been digging into it on your own for a while now, so you must understand.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um, I don't know why, but it's classified as a state secret now. Does that matter?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: I have to get closure on everything about you.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You really do, huh...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It could be a long and treacherous path, with your precious guns confiscated, the wicked watching you, hounding you to the mouth of hell?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Hm, that's weirdly specific.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: But no big deal. I run pretty fast. They'll never catch me!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You give up?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I give up. Not that anyone could ever tell you what to do.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That's not true. There's the boss. And Texas, I'll listen to Texas. Sometimes. Kinda.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya hear what they're whisperin' about?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: I think I heard most of the story already, but to tell the truth, I'm all kinds of curious right now.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: What kinda place is Laterano anyway?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Don't go digging too deep. It's her choice.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But what about Bison?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: He lost his temper quite a few times tonight. He'll get used to it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: He's an excellent new-comer to this industry. Is it okay to leave him like that?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Bison~ Lemme give ya a copy of the Great Foodie Guide. I did it up myself after real, in-person, on-site investigations!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You wrote the Foodie Guide!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Hehe. Advertisin's a real important revenue stream!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...Wow. Okay, you'll have to give me some secret recommendations.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: By the way, there's some fancy rich guy butler-looking dude standing outside the door?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Can ya really say he's outside the door when the walls are crumbled like so? *Sigh* And we have to pay the retainage for the small thruster this month...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...I'm going to get some air.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Young Master.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I know everything.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Father and Emperor had a deal at the same time a Siracusan gang came up against the Rat King, is that right?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Everything has a purpose, Young Master. You performed spectacularly well, given the circumstances. The Master of the House is most pleased.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: And yet, I...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Twice. That's how many times you followed my dad's order and did the trick with my shield.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Thank you... Young Master.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: *Sigh* Having been through so much, how can we still relax and enjoy a party over broken glass and splintered barstools?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: This kind of boundless optimism is born from the innumerable life-or-death experiences of a life well lived, Young Master.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I know. But they're Messengers. Why do they always risk their lives?

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: That's what a Messenger does. Should you leave home, leave the Master of the House, and leave Lungmen, you too will come to understand.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...I hope so.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Shall we head back and see the Master of the House?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Father's probably plotting something with Chief Wei right now. I'm sure it's something very important that I can't concern myself with.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: You are very clever, but the Master of the House did not make these choices to be rid of you. You will grow stronger, and more tenacious.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Maybe. I'm not sure if I really will see that day.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You go to my father. I need to... cut loose a bit.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: I understand. Do enjoy yourself, Young Master.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh, there was one more thing.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I did have a very good time tonight.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...Nnng...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: She gets drunk and makes trouble.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But she sure is cute when she's quiet, isn't she? A little sister to be proud of.
I don't care about her or her sister, but you need to stop her from digging any deeper into that stuff. We don't need that trouble.
Not to mention, the most important thing...
Weren't you just telling me not to talk in such a roundabout way?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What do you mean? Isn't it scarier how you can apparently hear everything I say all the time? Did you bug the place or something?
You should always remember who made me your keeper.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...Okay then, Miss 'Keeper,' what are you calling yourself these days?
Why do you ask?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It's time for your routine report, isn't it? I've been waiting all night. The big shots up top don't have any new ideas?
Why should I tell you?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I have a right to know. We're colleagues, aren't we?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: And I'm personally very interested in the way you change your duties each month.
Fine. I guess we would need codenames to refer to each other in case something happens.
I'm under the Notarial Hall this time. The usual. Independent special operations. Duty name... it's...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: What's the name?
...Suffering.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Um. What? Why?

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: How should I know! They said they watched some slasher flick and then decided they were going to change it to this with no explanation...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Suffering? All right. At least it's less cringey than last time's 'Chosen Overseer.'

steps.name: Chosen Overseer?
steps.text: Hmph. They're taking the piss out of someone else's job, and why did the Notarial Hall agree to it?

steps.name: Chosen Overseer?
steps.text: Did they think for even a moment, what if I had to meet Wei Yenwu? How am I supposed to announce myself?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: 'Hello. I'm Suffering from the Laterano Notarial Hall. It's a pleasure to meet you.'

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Was 'Tomb Knight' better? Or 'Super Sticky' from last month? Or 'Treasure Guardian' that came earlier than them?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: When you first volunteered to go with me, I really thought Laterano had an organization called the Treasure Guardians, you know...?

steps.name: Treasure Guardian?
steps.text: That's enough!

steps.name: Treasure Guardian?
steps.text: ...I'm writing a letter to Laterano right now. If they don't give me a perfectly ordinary assignment, they better not expect to get regular correspondences from me anymore.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: You need to understand where they're coming from. It's not easy to trust a horned Sankta.

steps.name: Treasure Guardian?
steps.text: Can't they just give me a normal assignment?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: An exceptional promotion would be cause for suspicion. And being so frantic all the time will give you wrinkles, Miss Suffering.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Woah, don't take it so seriously. Drawing your gun at the first disagreement is a pretty bad habit.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Whatever. Watching your performance all night made me sick. You're such a ham.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Then is it about time we leave Lungmen? I could take you shopping, as a way of making it up to you.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: ...Yeah, that's a good idea.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Which reminds me, you must've made a lot of money this time around? How about sending some my way? A little hospitality?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We're both from Laterano. Who's the host here?

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Fine. By the way, this angel's halo is blindingly bright.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: They get in the way sometimes.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Lucky you don't have that problem, fallen angel.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you jealous? I could buy you a fluorescent lamp to wear on your head.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Sounds like a pain. How do you deal with it?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Instinct. The moment we start using language, the halo appears.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Like the first time you blurt out 'mama' or 'dada?' What a beautiful image.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Haha. Exusiai's first word was 'sis.' Even though they're not blood related, they still...

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Enough. Let's not talk about her sister. Even if Laterano doesn't care, it's not a topic for casual conversation.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: It's because you leveled this precious gun at the captain that you fell.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Do you really plan to tell her the whole story someday? The little sister of your beloved battle-sister?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm... You've followed me this long and I still haven't told you. It might be that you, also my 'beloved battle-sister...' have a really bad temper?

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: I'm only under obligation to remind you that you must not speak even one word of what happened at Kazdel.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: But what about my travel memoir?

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Sounds great. Hey, why don't you go get your staff back from that freaky guy before I write you up for it.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: You're running out of time.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Yep. You're right. I'll do exactly as Suffering says.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: ...Boss, is there more work to do?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Before you leave Lungmen, I'll have a real pain in the ass job for you, no doubt.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Wait, you're not dead...? How much did you hear?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: A gentleman don't eavesdrop on two ladies havin' a private conversation.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Plus I don't need to. Bein' omniscient and all.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: ...so you heard everything.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Whatever. You're Emperor. It's fine.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Did you really feel like you wanted to kill him back there...? I guess that's our Suffering...

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: Shove it. Don't talk about me like I'm some kind of villain.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Would you ever consider joining Penguin Logistics? You wouldn't have to keep swapping around these cringey codenames.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: ...I must keep track of you, as a Laterano.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Right. It's just an idea I had. It's hard not to use your real name, you know.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight, time for you to bounce. This ain't a Laterano cathedral. We don't welcome Suffering here.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: I... whatever.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: I'm going to go... send a letter.

steps.name: Suffering?
steps.text: ...Damn it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Uh huh. Every one of them reports gets some government office swappin' your name around, huh? Seems like you're real popular over there.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I think at least half the reason they do it is just because it's fun for them.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: It's fun, huh? Mmm, makes sense. Sounds like at least a couple Laterano big shots know how to live.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: ...Hold up. Fun... someplace fun...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight, I got a idea. Mostima, you're gonna like this job. You know what? This job's gonna blow you away. You just wait 'til I hit you up.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: It really worries me when you talk like that, boss... But the sun's almost up. I better go find her.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Since everything here's all wrapped up with a nice little bow, it's time for me to leave. Say goodbye to everyone for me.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Especially Exusiai. And buy her dinner for me.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We all gonna see each other again real soon.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Wow... the sun's coming up.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: How do I get back? Uh oh... I think I'm lost...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh, I'm here. How do I always end up coming back here?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Is that...?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Mostima? Oh, she's praying. I better not bother her...

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: I wanna see the sunrise!

steps.name: Passerby
steps.text: Sorry, he's drunk. Can you let us by? Thanks!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Erm... Okay...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Damn! Mostima... she's already gone.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (But it looked like there was some kind of red shadow next to her? Did I see that right?)

steps.name: Punk
steps.text: Hey, that kid over there's in the way.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Punk
steps.text: You're the prince of MDL, aren't you? The rich as hell prince!

steps.name: Punk
steps.text: Why don't you come with us? Just need a minute of your time.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Again?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Um, heh heh, well...

steps.name: Punk
steps.text: What are you laughing at?

steps.name: Punk
steps.text: Hey! The little punk wants to fight! Let's get him, boys!
Speed of Light / DJ OKAWARI

Possibly being dead — The Gambino Family
Guest appearance while taking a walk — 'Rat King' of the Lungmen Slums

who clear any obstacle, solve any case, complete any job,
Penguin Logistics

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: This new car is great.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah! Let's go to the docks and seek revenge for Bison!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Texas, can ya take it a little slower, I'm puttin' some cream on Bison...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ah! Sorry!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What's to be sorry for? He got a bloody nose. Just cram the cream up there.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...It's okay. I'll do it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeah, that's about right for the son of that dumbass cow. Can't give anybody an inch.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: We got three hours and twenty-five minutes until we gotta see off Bison. That's more than enough time for a farewell party.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Let's see how many punks come at us.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to be a bother...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Bother? Nah. No bother.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Honestly, I been watchin' these wannabes for a while. They don't even know how to do crime.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Those clowns tryin' to share a city with us? That's a crime.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: That makes us sound like we're the most dangerous?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Just up ahead! That warehouse is their hideout!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Grab whatever you want. Texas, crash us on in there!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: On it!
